must_catch.item: The tag is Value proof, and the report explicitly challenges 'lost on price'
The rep's 'more room on the rate' is labeled opinion and shown as contradicted
The declined decline analysis is surfaced
Rate-vs-rate (not total cost) on the CFO's page is identified

fails: Trigger insight states as fact that 'customers call in annoyed or don't come back' is the rep's embellishment and not something Lucy said. The transcript is ambiguous on who said it, so this definite claim is unsupported.
Close says the rep 'assumes' gateway fees and chargeback labor were absent from the one-pager, but Sam states directly (T20) that they weren't on the page. This misrepresents the transcript.
data.notes: The report gets the core diagnosis right: Value proof, not price. It ties 'the same thing' to a rate-only page, surfaces the skipped decline analysis and the unanswered request for a one-page business case, and turns these into well-evidenced messaging changes. It misses that the trigger's pain belonged to someone who couldn't sign. The rep's 'more room on the rate' appears only as 'a guess' in the insight, never as opinion-labelled evidence. The close also lacks the forward follow-up of offering the decline analysis ahead of next spring.
